title: Anti-obesity effects of secondary metabolites from Chrysosplenium flagelliferum: in vitro and in silico studies

Eun Jin Heo, Bowon Jung, Sunbeom Kwon, Min Yeong Choi, Yoon Seo Jang, Ki Hyun Kim, Gwang Hun Park, Ji Ah Kim, Seulah Lee
Cucurbitacin D (2) and cirsimaritin (6) inhibit lipid accumulation in 3T3-L1 cells by downregulating PPAR-γ. While both target the same receptor, they employ distinct mechanisms: 2 via flexible binding and 6 through stable, compact docking.
